import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality with Stress Level and Physical Activity', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Add colorbar for Stress Level
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# Add legend for Physical Activity Level (simplified)
handles = [plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='gray', 
                      markersize=5, label='Low Activity'),
           plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='gray', 
                      markersize=10, label='Medium Activity'),
           plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='gray', 
                      markersize=15, label='High Activity')]
axes[0, 0].legend(handles=handles, title='Physical Activity', fontsize=9)

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Metrics by BMI Category
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_palette = {'Underweight': '#FF9999', 'Normal': '#66B2FF', 'Overweight': '#99FF99', 'Obese': '#FFCC99'}

for i, bmi in enumerate(bmi_order):
    bmi_data = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    axes[0, 1].hist(bmi_data['Sleep Duration'], bins=15, alpha=0.6, 
                    label=bmi, color=bmi_palette[bmi], density=True)

axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].legend(title='BMI Category', fontsize=10)

# 3. Average Metrics by Occupation (top 10 occupations)
occupation_stats = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean',
    'Daily Steps': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False).head(10)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_stats))
width = 0.2

bars1 = axes[1, 0].bar(x - width*1.5, occupation_stats['Sleep Duration'], width, 
                       label='Sleep Duration', color='skyblue', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = axes[1, 0].bar(x - width/2, occupation_stats['Quality of Sleep']/2, width, 
                       label='Quality/2', color='lightgreen', alpha=0.8)
bars3 = axes[1, 0].bar(x + width/2, occupation_stats['Stress Level'], width, 
                       label='Stress Level', color='salmon', alpha=0.8)
bars4 = axes[1, 0].bar(x + width*1.5, occupation_stats['Daily Steps']/2000, width, 
                       label='Daily Steps/2000', color='gold', alpha=0.8)

axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Normalized Values', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Average Sleep and Health Metrics by Occupation (Top 10)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(x)
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(occupation_stats.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
axes[1, 0].legend(fontsize=9)

# 4. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Variables
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
correlation_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()

mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(correlation_matrix, dtype=bool))
heatmap = axes[1, 1].imshow(correlation_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1, aspect='auto')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 1].set_yticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(numerical_cols, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
axes[1, 1].set_yticklabels(numerical_cols, fontsize=9)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Add correlation values
for i in range(len(numerical_cols)):
    for j in range(len(numerical_cols)):
        if not mask[i, j]:
            text = axes[1, 1].text(j, i, f'{correlation_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                                  ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=8)

# Add colorbar for heatmap
cbar2 = fig.colorbar(heatmap, ax=axes[1, 1], shrink=0.8)
cbar2.set_label('Correlation Coefficient', fontsize=10)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
